mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, conditions are clear at the Military Ridge State Trail, with temperatures holding at 62 degrees and a first quarter moon shining above.
The city is moving forward with the 2026 Comprehensive Plan, known as Envision Verona, which serves as a long-term guide for future development and community growth.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli or visit the Dane County Farmers Market.
Regarding local activity, on September 5th, officers responded to reports of cheese slices placed on vehicle windshields, which appeared to be a viral social media prank.
Culver's is closed for a remodel today, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
